$comment: Generated from RunEventLine in src/view/events.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. One line of a run's event stream, from reeval run --events (.reeval/events/<run>.ndjson by default), read by reeval attach.
title: RunEventLine

AntigravityHarnessDescriptor.description: The Antigravity CLI through `@reeval/harness-antigravity`, made by `antigravity()`.

effort.description: Reasoning effort passed as `agy --effort`, e.g. `low`, `medium`, `high` or `max`. The slug's `-low`/`-medium`/`-high` suffix is the same knob baked into `model`.

gateway.description: The gateway this harness's model calls go through, by name. It skips the config's `gateway` fallback: the plan refuses a gateway that isn't listed or can't serve this harness.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `antigravity:<model>`, or `antigravity:<model>[effort=<value>]` when `effort` is set.

maxConcurrent.description: The most Antigravity attempts at once, across the run, e.g. for the key's rate limits.

model.description: A model slug `agy models` lists for a Gemini API key, e.g. `gemini-3.8-flash-medium`.

startTimeout.description: How long the harness's session may take to become ready (its bootstrap and first session) before the attempt is an infra error, after one retry; default 90s.

capture.description: Set when the file came from `c.capture()`.

instructions.description: Goal strings only; wait beats omitted.

page.description: `artifacts/<name>.capture.json` beside the PNG: what the browser saw, a `CapturePage`.

pageErrors.description: How many uncaught exceptions and unhandled rejections the page had; absent when none.

status.description: The HTTP status of the page's document, after redirects; absent when no response came.

step.description: Set on the screenshot taken as one of the capture's instructions ended.

viewport.description: The live window, never the string `'full-page'`.

AssertionRecord.description: One `expect` or `expect.require` matcher call an attempt made, or a check another language made.

at.description: `path:line` of the call in the eval file, relative to the project root, when reeval saw it.

label.description: `label` is the supplied `expect` label. Without one, it is the matcher plus its first argument or named subject, cut at 60 characters. Repeats get ` #2`, ` #3`, and later suffixes.

message.description: Why it failed or couldn't answer, cut at 1 KB.

soft.description: A failure didn't end the eval's body: an `expect`. False for `expect.require` and for a check that threw, such as Python's `assert`, which end the body when they fail.

status.description: `error`: the matcher couldn't answer (a subject it can't read, an event the harness doesn't report).

AttemptAnswer.description: A question asked of one attempt on its own, and the model's answer. Never gates.

artifacts.description: The captures it sent, as asked: `true` for all, or their names.

choice.description: One of `choices`; unset on a free-text question and when the call failed.

choices.description: The answers it picked from; unset on a free-text question.

error.description: Why there's no answer: the model call failed. Outcomes never change.

input.description: `questions/<n>.json` under the attempt's directory: what the model was sent.

resolvedModel.description: The model id the provider says served the call, when it reports one.

stateOptions.description: What the attempt showed, every key resolved.

text.description: The model's answer, or its reason for `choice`; capped, and empty when the call failed.

AttemptError.description: Why an attempt failed; `prepare` when its sandbox couldn't be prepared, `resource` when it ran out of one, `provider` when the model provider stopped a turn.

artifacts.description: PNGs from `c.capture()`, under the `artifacts/<name>.png` path, then the page as each of its instructions ended, `artifacts/<name>.step-<n>.png`, kept when the capture fails too.

rawTranscript.description: Unnormalized harness stream parts, only with `REEVAL_RAW_TRANSCRIPT=1`.

setupLog.description: Each environment setup step's command, exit code, duration, and output.

AttemptMeta.description: Set when an attempt is registered, so the reporter has it even for skipped attempts.

bestOf.description: Set by `runs: { bestOf }`: past the majority's first attempts, this one runs only when the cell's earlier attempts haven't reached a majority.

brokered.description: The secrets this attempt brokers, as `NAME → host, host`.

family.description: Set when the eval is a case of an eval with `cases`.

files.description: The paths its environment's `files` write, layered and sorted; unset when there are none.

gate.description: How its cell's attempts decide the cell's outcome; `'none'` when they don't fail the run.

gateway.description: The gateway its harness resolved to; unset when no config, profile or pin names one.

inputs.description: The host files it reads, by absolute path: what its file's load read, then what its environment and sandbox name. Set only when the run context asks for `inputs`.

judge.description: Its judge's `'provider/model'`, as the config, profile, groups and eval set it, and the gateway its calls go through, so the run checks the judge's key before any attempt starts. Unset for a fake judge, a model object, or none.

label.description: The harness, then the role (with `compare`), plus `#n` when it has several runs.

minLift.description: Set on variant attempts whose compare has a `minLift`.

pluginBuilds.description: Its environment's plugins with a `build`, layered, which preflight builds into its image.

plugins.description: Its environment's plugins, layered: a local one's name and parts, else its source.

revision.description: The eval's `revision`, as the cascade resolved it; unset when no level sets one.

secretVars.description: The host variables its secrets read, by name: the CLI's own process masks their values on screen, since the attempt's worker is the only other process that knows them.

setBy.description: The levels that set its sandbox and harness: `reeval.config.ts`, `profiles.pr.defaults`, `group("net")` or `evaluate("x")`; with `pluginBuilds`, the environment its plugin builds come from (`environment review in evals/review.eval.ts`).

skip.description: Why this attempt does not run, e.g. it already completed in a resumed run.

source.description: Hashes of the eval's own source: what the `sources` fingerprint part covers but `revision`.

workspace.description: The git repository its workspace starts as, which the CLI fetches before any attempt.

activity.description: Counts from the transcript, so the attempt's activity is available without reading the transcript. `webSearches` includes refused searches. `fileEdits` counts edit tool calls, so a shell edit isn't one; `changedFiles` has what the workspace diff shows changed. `reasoningMs` is null when some turn's reasoning time is unknown, so a 0 is always a measurement.

fileEdits.description: The transcript's `file-edit` events: calls to the agent's file-editing tools, a Claude Code subagent's included. A file the agent changed from the shell, or through a subagent whose calls its harness doesn't stream (Cursor's `task`, Codex's `spawn_agent`), isn't counted: `changedFiles`, from the workspace diff, has every file the attempt changed.

maxToolMs.description: Longest tool `durationMs` in the transcript; null when none reported a duration.

reasoningMs.description: The turns' `reasoningMs` added up; null when any turn's is unknown, so a 0 is a measurement, never a harness that doesn't report it.

stalledTools.description: Transcript tool events with `stalled: true` (long shell or edit).

webSearches.description: Every `web-search` event, including refused ones. Null when a turn with none couldn't report them (`unreported`).

answers.description: The eval's questions asked of this attempt on its own (those without `across`), in question order; unset without any. They annotate: `outcome` never depends on them. Asked once the attempt ends, when it ran to a pass or a fail. Each answer's `input` is `questions/<n>.json` in the attempt's directory, `<n>` the question's place in the eval's `questions`.

askedModels.description: The models the harness's successful API calls asked for, when nothing named the one that served them (fx on Vercel AI Gateway with a Gemini model): the agent's word, not the gateway's, so never part of `servedModels`. Absent when there's none.

assertions.description: Every `expect` and `expect.require` matcher call that settled, in call order; unset with none.

bestOf.description: In a `runs: { bestOf }` cell: `added` when it ran past the majority's first attempts (the earlier ones split, or an infra error left them short), `skipped` when it didn't run because the earlier ones already had a majority. Unset on the attempts that always run.

captureUse.description: Tokens the capture vision loop used. Infrastructure only: never included in `usage`, effort, compare, or lift.

case.description: The case's key, on an eval with `cases`; see `EvalEntry.cases`.

changedFiles.description: Files under a dependency directory, such as the `node_modules/` directory or `.venv/` directory, collapse to one entry with `count`.

checks.description: Each foreground `c.exec`: its last try's exit code, and `durationMs` over all its tries. With `retries`, `tries` has each try's `{ exitCode, durationMs }` and the log each try's output.

retries.description: The `retries` it was given, when more than 0: it could run `retries + 1` times.

tries.description: Every try, in order, when it was given `retries`; its log has each try's output.

context.description: Skills, rules, and MCP config visible to the agent in its sandbox, by content hash.

cost.description: The gateway's billed `reportedCostUsd`, else the turns' costs added up; unset when a turn with tokens has none.

effort.description: The reasoning effort reeval asked the harness for: the factory's (`claudeCode({ effort: 'high' })`), or `medium` where it set none and the harness and model take one; null when reeval asked for none, leaving the CLI's own default. Fast is not this.

egress.description: The egress policy and, when the sandbox records it, the hosts contacted and refused; null if it never ran.

env.description: Names of the variables and secrets set in the sandbox, and the brokered ones; never values.

id.description: `<cell key>#<n>`, or `<cell key>#<case>#<n>` on an eval with `cases`: unique in its evaluation.

imageId.description: The image the container started from, in `stack.images`; null when the sandbox doesn't start from an image.

key.description: `<eval key> # <cell key>#<n>`, or `<eval key> [<case>] # <cell key>#<n>` on an eval with `cases`: unique in the run.

n.description: Run number within the cell, from 1.

observations.description: Each `c.observe(name, value)` the attempt made, one per name in first-call order with its last value; unset without any. They annotate: `outcome` never depends on them.

reportedCostUsd.description: What a gateway said the harness's own API calls cost, in US dollars, summed (OpenRouter's `usage.cost`); absent when it names none.

resources.description: The container or VM the attempt ran on and the CPU, memory and disk it used there, measured out of the agent's reach: a container's from a sibling container, a VM's as root (`AttemptResources`). Absent on the fake sandbox, which runs on the host, and in attempts that didn't reach their sandbox.

retries.description: The infra errors this attempt ended with before `reeval run --retry-errors` or `--resume` ran it again, oldest first: each `{ error, at }`, `at` being when that try started (null when it never did). The attempt's own `outcome` and `error` are its last try's. Absent when it never ran again.

sandboxBase.description: The saved image a `boat()` attempt with an image recipe ran in: the snapshot its VM started from and the image its container ran. Absent in other sandboxes, and in attempts that didn't reach their sandbox.

seq.description: Start order across the run, from 1; null for attempts that never started.

servedEffort.description: The reasoning effort the harness's API said it ran at, from `servedModels` or each turn's `model` (`medium` from `gpt-5.6-luna[effort=medium]`); null when those labels name none. Fast (`[fast=true]`) is not this.

servedModels.description: The models served by the harness's API calls, as observed by the egress gateway. Values may come from requests or responses and include reported effort; null when no model was named or recorded. The gateway reads the request URL for Antigravity, Goose, pi, and OpenCode on a `google/` model, so a request for `<model>-low` records `<model>`, and the API response for Codex, Grok Build, and OpenCode on another provider. Null for Cursor and Claude Code, whose API requests name no model.

serves.description: Each `c.serve` call that listened, in call order: `{ command, port, portEnv, detected, address, readyMs }`. `port` is where it listens; `detected` is true when that isn't the `PORT` it was given (`portEnv`), so reeval took the one port that started listening after the command did. Absent when the attempt served nothing.

setupProcesses.description: Processes the setup steps left running in a Docker sandbox with a `to: 'checks'` secret without `hosts` in their environment, so they hold its real value while the agent works and the agent, as the same user, can read it from them. Found by the secret's variable name, so a copy under another name or in a command's arguments isn't. At most 20, each `{ command, secrets }`: its command line, masked and cut at 200 characters, and those secrets' names. Absent when there were none.

snapshots.description: Copies of the attempt's workspace in its directory in `.reeval/runs` on the machine that ran it (never in the history folder), in the order taken: `turn-<n>` after each `c.send` with `snapshot: 'turns'`, then `final` after the checks. Each has its form, path and size, its file count, the directories left out by name, the files whose secret-looking values were masked and the binary ones left out for holding one, or why it wasn't taken. Absent with `snapshot: false`, and when the sandbox was gone first (a timeout or a cancel).

startRetries.description: Harness session starts that didn't become ready within `startTimeout`, or failed on a transient error (a 5xx or a network error), and were started again (at most one).

timeSplit.description: The turns' `timeSplit` added up, its `modelMs` null when any turn's is. Absent when no turn has one.

turns.description: `text` is the agent's final message, cut at 8 KB; the whole of it is in the `transcript.jsonl` file. `mcpStartup` times each stdio MCP server's start in the turn (`McpStartup`). `reasoningMs` is how long the turn's reasoning took, null when the harness can't time it.

cost.description: What the harness says the turn cost (Claude Code, pi), else its tokens at the list price of its model (or the cell's); unset when neither is known.

error.description: The turn's first error, such as a provider's billing or auth error, cut at 1 KB; else null.

mcpStartup.description: Each stdio MCP server start during the turn; see `McpStartup`.

model.description: The model the harness says served the turn; null when it reports none.

reasoningMs.description: Milliseconds the agent spent reasoning in the turn, the sum of the reasoning blocks its harness streamed; null when that's unknown: the harness can't time its reasoning (Codex's arrives whole, Antigravity's never), or the turn used reasoning tokens with no reasoning block, or had no block and no usage saying it used none, or never finished. Absent in records from before reeval recorded it, where a 0 on a real harness reads as an unknown `activity.reasoningMs`, and on the fake harness's finished turns, whose blocks are its script's.

timeSplit.description: Where the turn's time went: its model calls, tool calls, the background jobs it waited on, and the rest, summing to `durationMs` (`TimeSplit`). Absent in records from before reeval split it.

unreported.description: Event types the harness can't report; see `Turn.unreported`.

usage.description: Tokens the turn used; null when the harness reports none.

upstreams.description: The upstream providers a gateway said served the harness's own API calls (OpenRouter's `provider`), each with how many it served, in the order first seen; more than one means the gateway spread or failed the calls over between them. Absent when the gateway names none.

usage.description: Tokens across the attempt's turns; null when the harness reported none.

vmImage.description: The image a `tart()` attempt's VM was cloned from, with the digest Tart had for it. Absent in other sandboxes, and in attempts that didn't reach their sandbox.

AttemptResources.description: What an attempt's sandbox gave it and what it used, measured from when the sandbox started until teardown. A value the sandbox can't measure is left out, never estimated.

id.description: The VM's id at its provider, for a VM sandbox: Boat's or Daytona's sandbox id, or the name of `tart()`'s VM on its host.

memoryBytes.description: Memory the attempt could use, in bytes: the container's limit (a `daytona()` sandbox's too), else the VM's total (a macOS VM's `sysctl hw.memsize`).

name.description: The name reeval gave the VM, where the provider keeps one apart from its id.

size.description: The provider's machine size, where it has sizes: `boat({ type })`, `daytona({ size })`.

vcpus.description: CPUs the attempt could use: the container's CPU quota (a `daytona()` sandbox's too), else the CPUs the VM has (a macOS VM's `sysctl hw.ncpu`).

scope.description: `container`: the container's own cgroup, so only the attempt's processes count (Docker, Podman). `machine`: the whole VM, its system processes included (`boat()`, `daytona()`, `tart()`).

shared.description: The VM ran other attempts at the same time (`attemptsPerMachine` above 1), so its whole-VM usage isn't this attempt's: `usage` is left out.

usage.description: What it used; absent when the sandbox gave no readings (a macOS VM has no `/proc`).

avgCores.description: `cpuSeconds` over `durationMs`: how many CPUs it kept busy on average.

cgroupPeakMemoryBytes.description: cgroup v2's `memory.peak`, in bytes: the highest `memory.current` the kernel saw since the container started, page cache included, so no spike is missed but it reads higher than `peakMemoryBytes`. `container` scope and `daytona()` on Linux 5.19 or later only.

cpuSeconds.description: CPU time over `durationMs`, in seconds: user and system, every CPU added up.

diskReadBytes.description: Bytes the VM's disks read over `durationMs`; `machine` scope only, not `daytona()`.

diskWriteBytes.description: Bytes the VM's disks wrote over `durationMs`; `machine` scope only, not `daytona()`.

durationMs.description: Milliseconds between the first reading and the last.

p95Cores.description: The 95th percentile of the CPUs it kept busy between two readings, a second apart: what it needed but for its busiest twentieth of the time. Absent with fewer than two readings.

partial.description: The sandbox went before the last reading (a timeout or cancel): the values stop at the last sample.

peakCores.description: The most CPUs it kept busy between two readings; absent with fewer than two.

peakMemoryBytes.description: The highest memory reading, in bytes, page cache the kernel can reclaim left out: the cgroup's `memory.current` less its `inactive_file`, or the VM's `MemTotal` less `MemAvailable`. Sampled, so a spike between readings is missed.

sampleMs.description: Milliseconds between readings while the attempt ran.

throttling.description: How often the container's CPU quota held it back over `durationMs`, from cgroup v2's `cpu.stat`: `periods` is `nr_periods` (quota periods it ran in), `throttledPeriods` `nr_throttled` (those it used up its quota in and waited out) and `throttledSeconds` `throttled_usec`. `container` scope and `daytona()` only.

AttemptRetry.description: An infra error an attempt ended with before it ran again, and when that try started.

BoatApiKey.description: The host variable holding a Boat API key, made by `secret.fromEnv`.

BoatSandboxDescriptor.description: A boat.dev VM per attempt, made by `boat()` from `reeval/sandbox/boat`.

apiKey.description: The host variable with the Boat API key, read on the host only.

attemptsPerMachine.description: The attempts one machine runs at once, each as a user of its own with its own home (which each sees at `/home/reeval`), workspace and egress gateway. The harness installs once per machine, and every other slot's home gets its own copy of the install. Default 1. A harness whose bridge takes a fixed port in the machine (Claude Code, OpenCode, Goose, fx, Grok Build) runs one per machine, unless the sandbox has an image recipe: then each attempt is a container with a network of its own.

dockerfile.description: A Dockerfile, absolute or relative to the directory of the file it's written in, built from its directory with `REEVAL_BASE` set to reeval's sandbox image.

from.description: A Debian or Ubuntu based toolchain image; reeval bakes Node and the harness on top.

id.description: Cell id; defaults to `boat`, plus `:<type>` with a `type` and `:<image>` with an image recipe, and an install hash.

image.description: An image that already has the harness baked in, pulled from its registry on a build VM. With any of `image`, `from`, `dockerfile` or `install`, preflight builds the image once into a Boat saved snapshot, and each attempt runs in a container of it on a VM started from the snapshot.

install.description: Baked onto the sandbox image in one build container: in order, no secrets, no workspace.

maxConcurrent.description: The most attempts on Boat at once, across the run: machines times `attemptsPerMachine`.

prefix.description: The start of every sandbox name reeval gives Boat, so a run's cleanup finds only its own: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

reuse.description: A machine takes another of the run's attempts once one ends, instead of being deleted: its user's processes, cron jobs and files are removed and its home put back as it was after the harness installed, which isn't installed again. Default false, one attempt per slot.

CaptureOptions.description: Camera defaults for `c.capture()`. Cascades config → profile defaults → group → eval, shallow-merged. `viewport` on a level replaces the whole value. `port` is not an option: pass it as the first argument to `c.capture`.

browser.description: `false` refuses the host `chrome-headless-shell` binary. `c.capture()` then throws.

model.description: Vision model for `instructions`. Cascades like `question`. Default is `analysis.model`, else the attempt's judge model, whichever is first a language model; never Jev.

timeout.description: How long to poll before failing; a 502, 503 or 504 is polled past until then. Default `'60s'`.

viewport.description: The window and saved PNG size, or `'full-page'`. Default 1280×720.

CaptureStep.description: One instruction of a capture, as it ended. Its screenshot is `artifacts/<name>.step-<index>.png`, beside the capture's own `artifacts/<name>.png`.

ended.description: `final`: the model marked a move as finishing it. `done`: the model said the goal was met. `stopped`: it stopped the capture (its timeout, the move cap, a repeated move or an error).

index.description: Its place among the capture's goal strings, from 1.

moves.description: Moves made on the page for it.

ms.description: Milliseconds from its first look at the page to its screenshot.

CaptureWindow.description: Live tab size for `c.capture()`. Default 1280×720 when the call and cascade omit `viewport`.

CaseRecord.description: One case of an eval with `cases`, and how its attempts went.

answers.description: The eval's pairwise questions, answered over this case's attempts; unset without any.

cells.description: Its own cells: their attempts are those with this `case`.

excluded.description: The environments (and harnesses) `where` left this case out of; unset when none.

hash.description: `EvalEntry.source.case`: the hash of the case's data.

index.description: Its place in the case list, from 0.

key.description: The case's key: `nextjs` for the case keyed `nextjs`.

name.description: The name it ran under in a record from before an eval with `cases` was one entry, when that isn't `<eval name> [<key>]` (a name template's, `fixes GH-101` for `fixes $id`).

outcome.description: What the case did, over its own cells by each cell's gate. Under a `gate: { passRate }`, the eval's cell gates on the mean over the cases, so `verdict` says this outcome decides nothing.

passRate.description: pass@1 over its gated cells' attempts.

verdict.description: `family` when a cell's `gate: { passRate }` gates the mean over the cases, not this case.

Cell.description: A cell of an evaluation combines a harness, an environment (`-` when none is set), and that environment's sandbox id. With `compare`, the control is `compare.control` and each variant is that environment on its own, including its sandbox.

environment.description: The environment's own name, also on a variant cell (`with-skill`, with no prefix).

harness.description: The harness id: `id` when set, otherwise `<kind>:<model>` (`<kind>` alone without a model), with `[effort=<value>]` appended whenever `effort` is set.

key.description: The harness id, the environment name, and the sandbox id, joined with `/`.

role.description: `variant` on a compare's variant cell, else `control`: the compare's control, or any cell of an eval without `compare`, each environment of an `environments` grid included. A variant's lift is against the `control` cell on its harness and sandbox.

sandbox.description: The sandbox id is `id` when set, or `fake` for the fake sandbox. A Docker sandbox starts with the engine (`docker` by default). It adds `:` and the sanitized final component of `image` or `from`, or for `dockerfile` the sanitized filename (the parent directory name when that filename is `Dockerfile` and a parent is present). Non-empty `install` steps append `+` and an eight-character hash.

traits.description: The environment's merged traits; unset when it has none. Not part of the key.

variant.description: The variant's name, for variant cells.

CellCheck.description: One check over a cell's counted attempts. `verdict` (variant cells) is `discriminates` when every answered instance passes on one side and fails on the other, `both-pass` when every answered instance passes on both sides, `both-fail` when every answered instance fails on both sides, or `mixed` otherwise. It is absent when either side has no pass or fail.

CellGate.description: A cell's gate: its policy, or `'none'` when its failures don't fail the eval (a control's, or any cell under `gate: 'observe'`).

CellRate.description: A cell's pass@1 over an eval's cases.

cases.description: Cases with at least one counted attempt in this cell.

outcome.description: Set with `passRate`: `fail` when `rate` is below it.

pass.description: Passes and counted attempts over those cases.

passRate.description: The cell's `gate: { passRate }`: with cases it gates `rate`, not each case's pass@1.

rate.description: The mean of the cases' pass@1; at one attempt a case, `pass / counted`.

CellRecord.description: One harness and environment of an evaluation, and how its attempts went.

bestOf.description: Set by `runs: { bestOf }`: the cell stopped once a majority of this many attempts agreed, and gates on that majority. `runs` still counts every planned attempt, the skipped ones included.

checks.description: Each assertion, by label, seen in any attempt of the evaluation, over this cell's counted attempts; on a variant cell, the control's beside it. Unset when no attempt recorded any.

cost.description: The cell's attempts' agent and judge costs added up; unset where none has one.

effort.description: The reasoning effort reeval asked the harness for: the factory's, or `medium` where it set none and the harness and model take one; null when reeval asked for none, leaving the CLI's own default. Fast is not this.

environment.description: The environment's own name, also on a variant cell (`with-skill`, with no prefix).

environmentDigest.description: The environment's digest; null for none. With `environment`, the key into `RunRecord.environments`: environments with the same contents share a digest.

fingerprint.description: `sha256` of `fingerprintParts`; results are comparable only when it matches.

gate.description: How the attempts decide the cell's outcome; `'none'` when it doesn't fail the evaluation.

gateway.description: The gateway in the config's `gateway` list its harness resolved to (`direct` is each provider's own key); unset when no config, profile or pin named one.

harness.description: The harness id: `id` when set, otherwise `<kind>:<model>` (`<kind>` alone without a model), with `[effort=<value>]` appended whenever `effort` is set.

key.description: The harness id, the environment name, and the sandbox id, joined with `/`.

lift.description: Unset on an eval with several `cases`, whose variants have `EvalEntry.lifts`.

model.description: The configured harness model, when it has one.

outcome.description: By `gate`. `'all'` (pass^k: every counted attempt passes) matches `{ passRate: 1 }`; `{ passRate }` is a pass@1 threshold. Infra only when nothing counted; `'none'` reports the worst outcome. A variant below its `minLift` fails too.

overrides.description: Environment keys the variant replaced on the control's (or a child on its parent's).

passRate.description: pass@1: pass / (pass + fail); infra errors and skips excluded.

rate.description: On an eval with several `cases`: the cell's pass@1 over them. A `gate: { passRate }` gates `rate.rate`, the mean of the cases' pass@1, and sets `rate.outcome`.

role.description: `variant` on a compare's variant cell, else `control`: the compare's control, or any cell of an eval without `compare`, each environment of an `environments` grid included. A variant's lift is against the `control` cell on its harness and sandbox.

sandbox.description: The sandbox id is `id` when set, or `fake` for the fake sandbox. A Docker sandbox starts with the engine (`docker` by default). It adds `:` and the sanitized final component of `image` or `from`, or for `dockerfile` the sanitized filename (the parent directory name when that filename is `Dockerfile` and a parent is present). Non-empty `install` steps append `+` and an eight-character hash.

traits.description: The environment's merged traits; unset when it has none. Not part of the key.

variant.description: The variant's name, for variant cells.

CheckTally.description: How often one check passed: a counted attempt that never reached it counts it `notRun`.

CostUsd.description: A dollar figure and where it came from.

basis.description: `reported`: what the harness (Claude Code, pi) or the gateway (OpenRouter) said it cost; `estimated`: the tokens at list prices, which leave out discounts and long-context rates.

source.description: Who reported it (`claude-code`, `pi`, `openrouter`, `fake`), or the prices it was estimated at (`models.dev 2026-11-05`, a `REEVAL_PRICES` file); several, joined with `, `, in a sum.

CursorHarnessDescriptor.description: Cursor's agent through the Cursor TypeScript SDK's local runtime (`@reeval/harness-cursor-sdk`), made by `cursor()`. It reports each turn's tokens.
